name: TextRemover.video
tagline: Remove text and subtitles from videos with AI, right in your browser.
description: TextRemover.video helps creators remove unwanted text, captions and hardcoded subtitles from videos using AI background reconstruction. Upload an MP4 or MOV file, then choose Select area, Subtitles or All text. The browser-based workflow supports landscape and portrait videos without installing editing software. Eligible signed-in accounts receive 30 free processing seconds each month, with no credit card required. Paid options include monthly and annual subscriptions, plus one-time credit packs. Processing costs one credit per video second, rounded up per clip.
